manifest.source_simulator_compile_step: Build simulator baseline and run the explicit iOS test target

visual_review.flag_interpretation: SpringBoard/app-window launch and inter-launch transitions, plus changes confined to Dynamic Island/status pixels; no timing or device-performance claim.

archive_pipeline_and_history.fixture_boundary: Production encrypted Postbox, durable capture outbox, SQLCipher/account facade and loader fixtures with synthetic keys and locally invoked replay/deletion helpers; no live Telegram account, server RPC or actual conversation placement. Includes the separately identified timed-media exclusion and transfer classes.

archive_settings_and_navigation_helpers.fixture_boundary: Catalog, routing/identity helpers, status nodes, serialized thumbnail reads, preview classification and transfer-file lifecycle fixtures; no authenticated full-screen Settings/gallery navigation or full-app visual proof.

archive_storage_transfer_and_key_queries.fixture_boundary: Real SQLCipher/archive file fixtures cover account isolation, quotas, retention, migration rollback and authenticated backup. KeychainArchiveKeyStoreTests inject fake Keychain operations; they do not verify physical-device Keychain unlock, biometric UI or SideStore provisioning.

disappearing_timed_view_once_exclusions.fixture_boundary: These eleven cases verify deliberate archive exclusion and preservation of normal consumption/expiry behavior. They do not verify retention of disappearing, timed or view-once content. Such retention is unsupported in this candidate.

encrypted_import_export_account_facade.fixture_boundary: Real Postbox/account coordinator and SQLCipher with synthetic keys; validates authenticated owner/environment binding, paused capture, open/close ordering and seven deferred-transfer authority/cancellation cases. Native document picker and authenticated account navigation remain unverified.

encrypted_media_playback.fixture_boundary: Native generated fixtures decode PNG/JPEG, true GIF, PDF, AAC, Ogg/Opus and H264/audio through reopened encrypted storage. Separate capture fixtures use synthetic typed bytes; neither demonstrates every format arriving through live Telegram or actual gallery playback.

ghost_and_story_warning.fixture_boundary: Production privacy workers and account preferences use final typed RPC recorders rather than live network calls. Request suppression/cancellation, independent policy and required expiry behavior are tested; server behavior, perfect invisibility and another client are not.

local_cosmetic_preferences.fixture_boundary: Real local preference persistence/reopen and entitlement boundary tests; native OS icon switching and physical-device appearance remain unverified.

local_folder_appearance.fixture_boundary: Real Postbox preference/schema/projection and serialized-request invariance tests; native account editor/tab recordings remain unverified. No server Premium entitlement is granted.

local_sponsored_message_policy.fixture_boundary: Local consumer projection and account policy fixtures; no server entitlement, live sponsored-message behavior or Telegram API-policy clearance.

message_filters_core.fixture_boundary: Production account preferences, bounded matchers and metadata classification are tested. Actual chat hide/reveal presentation is covered by the separate twenty-five unexecuted Projection cases, not these Core passes.

reviewed_local_telemetry_paths.fixture_boundary: Selected producer/persistence cleanup tests; not a runtime proof of no telemetry or all network connections.

startup_storage_and_keychain_scoping.fixture_boundary: Storage choice and Keychain query scoping fixtures include noninteractive LAContext/host metadata checks. They do not verify an installed physical device, real unlock/biometric prompts or independent provisioning.

latest_deferred_profile_preparation.fix: exact reviewed audit-tooling paths allowed; neighboring paths rejected

media_scope.capture: Real local encrypted capture/durability fixtures include completed photos and synthetic typed video, round-video, voice, GIF and document bytes, including a 20 MiB streamed document.
media_scope.decoder: The separate eighteen-case encrypted-playback suite includes native decoding of generated real media formats; loader, cancellation and boundary cases are not all decoding tests.
media_scope.unsupported: Timed, self-destructing and view-once retention is not implemented; eleven cases confirm exclusion and normal consumption.

parsing.source: Actual XCTest started/terminal markers in published test.log files, including markers preceded by concurrent console output; Bazel test.xml wrapper counts are not native method counts.

remaining_application_verification: Authenticated Settings entry, account-bound destinations, persistence controls and switching accounts in the complete app.
Actual conversation placement, filter hide/reveal, archived-row projection and gallery/search playback.
Live incoming media and sender-deletion/edit interactions with another Telegram client.
Physical lock/unlock, actual OS termination, low-storage behavior, network privacy and device performance.
The original qualification and later iPhone 15 Pro replay have not executed the forty-one Projection assertions.

Automatic App Group/private-storage fallback, Apple HTTP 403 resolution, independent signing, SideStore installation and the reported physical iOS 27.2 behavior; the passing simulator control explicitly seeds fresh private storage.
retained_diagnostic_attempt_inventory_sc: Selected audited retained replays; not an exhaustive list of all workflow jobs.

retained_diagnostic_attempts.signing_control_limit: Tiny control used manual ad-hoc signing with the captured host debug entitlement; this is not independent proof of Xcode default signing behavior.

retained_diagnostic_attempts.visual_scene: SpringBoard with runner-labelled installation progress; no settings app

retained_diagnostic_attempts.assertion: XCTWaiterResult timedOut (2), expected completed (1), while waiting for Keyboard.exists == false
Archive switch value Optional("0") did not equal expected Optional("1") after one tap

scope: Feature evidence from the original c55 native qualification, separately identified historical renderer and current retained-artifact hosted/UI tests, and exact-source startup/device packaging. Each result retains its own origin; the original full qualification remains failed.
